function.name: control_lights
function.description: Turn lights on or off in a room, dim them to a brightness percentage, or set their color. A color request means action on. Never use this for blinds, fans, or any other device.

brightness_percent.description: Brightness from 0 to 100. A dim request with a number must carry it in this same call.

color.description: The light color; include only when the user names one.

function.name: set_thermostat
function.description: Set the home thermostat to a target temperature in degrees Celsius. This never controls fans, lights, or any other device.

function.name: control_fan
function.description: Turn a room fan on or off, optionally at a stated speed. This never changes the thermostat.

room.description: The room whose fan to control.

speed.description: Fan speed; include only when stated.

function.name: control_blinds
function.description: Open or close the window blinds in one stated room. Never pick the room yourself. Never use this for lights or the vacuum.

room.description: The room whose blinds to move.

function.name: start_robot_vacuum
function.description: Start or stop the robot vacuum, or send it back to its dock to charge.

room.description: The room to clean; include only when starting a run in a stated room.
